summary: This CSS defines a glassmorphic container with a frosted-glass effect and rounded corners, plus styling for images inside it that enlarge and glow when you hover over them. The container uses a semi-transparent background with a blur effect to create a modern, layered look, while the images animate smoothly when interacted with.

explanations.4: The rgba color notation with four values lets you control transparency—the last 0.15 means 15% opacity, so you get a very subtle white tint.
explanations.7: backdrop-filter applies effects to what's *behind* the element, so the blur makes the background blurry and saturate makes colors more vivid, creating that frosted-glass effect.
explanations.13: This is a shorthand way to animate multiple properties at once—transform, box-shadow, and filter will all smoothly transition over 0.4 seconds when their values change.
explanations.20: scale(1.05) makes the image 5% bigger, and translateY(-4px) moves it up 4 pixels, so hovering lifts and enlarges the image slightly.
